FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) ACT 1982

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) (FEE FOR PURCHASE OF LOCAL PLAN

(ALTERATION 3) (PART II)) RULES 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 64(2)(j)

of the Federal Territory (Planning) Act 1982 [Act 267], the Commissioner of

the City of Kuala Lumpur, with the approval of the Minister, makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Federal Territory (Planning)

(Fee for Purchase of Local Plan (Alteration 3) (Part II)) Rules 2021.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 9 August 2021.

Fee

2. The fee for the purchase of a copy of the Kuala Lumpur City Plan 2020

(Alteration 3) (Part II) shall be as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Rule 2]

Copy Fee per copy

(RM)

Hard copy 100.00

Electronic form 50.00

Made 23 July 2021

[DBKL/JUP/BPPP/GN/808 JLD. 8; PN(PU2)396/VIII]
